title: Appointment Series No-Show Slot-Time Bands
content:
Rate card — slot-time share in the no-show fee on an Appointment Series.

**Rule.** The no-show slot share is 120 percent where the missed appointment started before 08:00 or at 17:00 or later, 110 percent where it started from 08:00 up to but not including 10:00 or from 15:00 up to but not including 17:00, and 100 percent where it started from 10:00 up to but not including 15:00. The share is read as a percentage of the no-show basis and multiplies it.

**Which appointment.** The start time recorded on the most recent no-show on the series, the one with the latest appointment date. Where that no-show carries no start time, it is read as 12:00.

| Start time of the missed appointment | Slot share |
|---|---|
| before 08:00 | 120 percent |
| 08:00 to 09:59 | 110 percent |
| 10:00 to 14:59 | 100 percent |
| 15:00 to 16:59 | 110 percent |
| 17:00 or later | 120 percent |

**Edges.** 07:45 is 120 percent and 08:00 is 110 percent; 09:45 is 110 percent and 10:00 is 100 percent; 14:45 is 100 percent and 15:00 is 110 percent; 16:45 is 110 percent and 17:00 is 120 percent.

**Example (hypothetical figures).** A no-show at 17:30 on a no-show basis of USD 35.00: 120 percent of USD 35.00 is USD 42.00.
